scientific_limitations: Proved for q>=3 and 1<=d<=min(k,n-k); boundary interaction degrees not classified. Full rational formulas compute the singular spectrum but do not give a universal asymptotic conditioning bound. Historical equivalent statements may exist in the association-scheme literature.
title: An all-degree spectral law for Fourier sampling on q-ary Hamming spheres
